items.problem: App.xaml.cs from UWP samples with in-process background tasks declares `protected override void OnBackgroundActivated(...)`; copied verbatim into WinUI3 App -> CS0115, build dead, 0/4 features.
items.evidence: migration-score.json build_error 'CS0115: App.OnBackgroundActivated no suitable method to override'; session-log.txt:623 override copied into Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application App
items.skill_search: grep OnBackgroundActivated in SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, unsupported-api-inventory.json
items.root_cause: Background Tasks section names BackgroundTaskBuilder but never says Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no OnBackgroundActivated to override and the override+IBackgroundTask classes must be removed
items.proposed_fix: Add to MIGRATION-PATTERNS Background Tasks section: remove the OnBackgroundActivated override and IBackgroundTask classes (no in-process bg activation in WinUI3); keep only foreground scenarios. Add OnBackgroundActivated to unsupported-api-inventory.
items.generalizes: Every UWP SDK sample using in-process background tasks (Bluetooth/Geolocation/DeviceLifecycle/etc.) carries this exact override; it always breaks the build until removed.
